scripts.check:ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:all && pnpm run build
scripts.check:pre-push: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:all
scripts.db:prepare: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait postgres && pnpm run db:push
scripts.db:prepare:dev: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait postgres && pnpm run db:push:dev
scripts.db:push: pnpm --dir packages/db exec drizzle-kit push --config drizzle.dev.config.ts --force
scripts.db:push:dev: pnpm --dir packages/db exec drizzle-kit push --config drizzle.dev.config.ts --force
scripts.db:push:prod: pnpm --dir packages/db exec drizzle-kit push --config drizzle.prod.config.ts --force
scripts.db:push:stg: pnpm --dir packages/db exec drizzle-kit push --config drizzle.stg.config.ts --force
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait postgres
scripts.test:all: bun test apps packages --pass-with-no-tests && bun test --timeout 120000 --max-concurrency=1 ./test/api-integration/**/*.test.ts
